Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi

Interface StreamResultSink<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type being published, typically InferenceResult or a rule-engine Decision
public interface StreamResultSink<T>
Extension point for publishing inference results (or rule-engine decisions) to a configured downstream stream/messaging system. otter-stream-kafka's InferenceResultKafkaSerializationSchema/OtterKafkaSinks cover Kafka via Flink's native KafkaSink; this interface is the generic shape for anything else (Kinesis, Pulsar, a webhook, an internal event bus) a project wants to wire up the same way.

Deliberately minimal — a single send method — since the actual delivery mechanics (batching, retries, partitioning, delivery guarantees) are provider-specific and better expressed through each target system's own idiomatic client/Flink connector (as otter-stream-kafka does by wrapping Flink's real KafkaSink rather than reimplementing delivery semantics). This interface exists so a project can depend on one stable type when its downstream target is pluggable/configurable, not to replace system-specific sink implementations.

Since:
0.1.0
